# 3101 - 64-bit (16 x 4) bipolar RAM, open-collector outputs

Package DIP-16 · family bipolar-memory · catalogue file [catalog/chips/3101.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/3101.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 61 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![3101 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/3101.png) | ![3101 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-3101.png) | ![3101 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-3101.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | A0 | input |  |  |  |
| 2 | CS | enable | low |  | controls pins 5, 7, 9, 11; when not enabled: high |
| 3 | WE | input | low |  |  |
| 4 | D1 | input |  |  |  |
| 5 | O1 | output |  | open-collector |  |
| 6 | D2 | input |  |  |  |
| 7 | O2 | output |  | open-collector |  |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 9 | O3 | output |  | open-collector |  |
| 10 | D3 | input |  |  |  |
| 11 | O4 | output |  | open-collector |  |
| 12 | D4 | input |  |  |  |
| 13 | A3 | input |  |  |  |
| 14 | A2 | input |  |  |  |
| 15 | A1 | input |  |  |  |
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 5,7,9,11 | On = NOT mem[A3..A0][n] when CS' AND WE; else high (off) | Selected (CS low) and reading (WE high): outputs give the complement of the stored word. During a write, or when not selected, the outputs are high (open collector off). |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 64


## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 15 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | VCC 5 V +-5%, TA 0-75 C. VOL 0.45 V at IOL 15 mA; output leakage 100 uA max at 5.25 V. VIL 0.85 V, VIH 2.0 V. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V +-5%, TA 0-75 C, output load 15 mA and 30 pF, measured at 1.5 V.

| From | To | Edge | Min ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | O | access | 10 | 60 |
| CS | O | access | 5 | 42 |
| WE | O | recovery |  | 50 |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin | Against | Min ns |
|---|---|---|---|
| pulseWidth | WE (tWP) |  | 40 |
| setup | D (data-write overlap tDW) | WE | 40 |
| hold | write recovery tWR | WE | 5 |

## Not known

- Output pull-up voltage limit for the open collector is only the absolute maximum (-0.5..+7 V); outputMaxVoltageV left null.
- Exact reference edges for tDW and tWR were taken from the parameter names; the write-cycle waveform was only partly legible.

## Notes

ND title says "equal to 7489". The National DM74L89A sheet (1976 National Memory Databook pdf 73) says pin compatible with SN7489, 3101, MM5501.

## Sources

- [Intel 1976 Data Catalog, 3101/3101A high speed fully decoded 64 bit memory](https://www.bitsavers.org/components/intel/_dataBooks/1976_Intel_Data_Catalog.pdf) - pdf 97-99 (printed 2-87..2-89); 3101 (not 3101A)

## Used on sheets

No sheet in this repository uses this chip yet.
